verdict.rationale: Poly ships its own in-app agent, so acting as an MCP client is a fair axis. However, every MCP item in the evidence describes Poly as an MCP server that external assistants like Claude or VS Code connect to. Nothing shows users adding third-party MCP servers to Poly's agent, and server-side evidence does not transfer to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
